facilities.title: Hostel
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence Academy offers a safe, comfortable, and disciplined environment, with well-maintained hostel facilities. Students will get clean rooms, individual beds, and a disciplined routine.

facilities.title: Mess
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence Academy serves fresh, hygienic, and nutritious meals to the students. The meal is prepared in such a way so that it balances the nutrients and keeps the students fresh and energetic every day.

facilities.title: Temple
facilities.longDescription: A temple is a place of symbol and peace. Prince Defence has a beautiful temple in its campus where students can pray and always stay positive.

facilities.title: Gymnasium
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence offers a well-equipped gymnasium where students can build strength, stamina, and fitness under the guidance of experts. Here, students are trained safely and regularly, turning discipline into a daily habit.

facilities.title: Library
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence Academy offers library facilities to the students where they can read books and do self-study in a quiet corner. It helps the students for serious learning and collecting information and knowledge from books in a distraction-free environment.

facilities.title: Events and Competitions
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence Academy Sikar provides a platform for students where they can show their talent by performing under pressure and celebrate each other’s wins through Events and Competitions.

facilities.title: Sports
facilities.longDescription: A defence is incomplete without sports, and sports are a core part of life at Prince Defense Academy. From running tracks to team games, daily play sharpens fitness, builds team spirit and teaches cadets to stay determined, win or lose.

facilities.title: Physical Ground
facilities.longDescription: Prince Defence Academy features a vast, standard physical training ground designed for rigorous defence preparation. It provides standard tracks and obstacle courses to build endurance, agility, and absolute physical readiness for defence exams.
